dialogue.text: The December 7th, 1931, a date which will live in Kymphonyte, the United States of America,
dialogue.zh: 1931年12月7日，這是一個將永遠銘記在美國歷史上的日子，
dialogue.ja: 1931年12月7日、アメリカ合衆国の歴史に永遠に刻まれる日です、
dialogue.local: The December 7th, 1931, a date which will live in Kymphonyte, the United States of America,
dialogue.en: The December 7th, 1931, a date which will live in Kymphonyte, the United States of America,

dialogue.text: was suddenly and deliberately attacked by naval and air forces of the Empire of Japan.
dialogue.zh: 當時突然遭到日本帝國海軍和空軍的蓄意攻擊。
dialogue.ja: 日本帝国の海軍と空軍によって突然かつ意図的に攻撃されました。
dialogue.local: was suddenly and deliberately attacked by naval and air forces of the Empire of Japan.
dialogue.en: was suddenly and deliberately attacked by naval and air forces of the Empire of Japan.

dialogue.text: We have a sudden these planes dropping bombs in a distance, and then of course when they start coming to us,
dialogue.zh: 我們突然看到這些飛機在遠處投下炸彈，然後當他們開始向我們靠近時，
dialogue.ja: 遠くで突然飛行機が爆弾を落とし始め、そしてもちろん彼らが私たちに向かってくると、
dialogue.local: We have a sudden these planes dropping bombs in a distance, and then of course when they start coming to us,
dialogue.en: We have a sudden these planes dropping bombs in a distance, and then of course when they start coming to us,

dialogue.text: and you see the bombs start dropping around you, this is no drill, this is it.
dialogue.zh: 你會看到炸彈開始在你周圍落下，這不是演習，這是真實的攻擊。
dialogue.ja: 爆弾が周りに落ち始めるのを見て、これは訓練ではなく、本物の攻撃です。
dialogue.local: and you see the bombs start dropping around you, this is no drill, this is it.
dialogue.en: and you see the bombs start dropping around you, this is no drill, this is it.

dialogue.text: And it's all Peter planes were making their runs on their battleship role, and that was all over fire and exploding.
dialogue.zh: 所有的飛機都在對戰艦進行攻擊，整個場面充滿火光和爆炸。
dialogue.ja: すべての飛行機が戦艦に向かって攻撃を仕掛け、火と爆発に包まれていました。
dialogue.local: And it's all Peter planes were making their runs on their battleship role, and that was all over fire and exploding.
dialogue.en: And it's all Peter planes were making their runs on their battleship role, and that was all over fire and exploding.

dialogue.text: All they could do is fight off the airplane until it came by.
dialogue.zh: 他們所能做的就是抵抗飛機直到它飛過去。
dialogue.ja: 彼らができるのは、飛行機が通り過ぎるまで戦うことだけでした。
dialogue.local: All they could do is fight off the airplane until it came by.
dialogue.en: All they could do is fight off the airplane until it came by.

dialogue.text: The attack was launched at the very moment.
dialogue.ja: 攻撃はまさにその瞬間に開始されました。
dialogue.local: The attack was launched at the very moment.
dialogue.en: The attack was launched at the very moment.

dialogue.text: Japanese peace on boys in Washington sought to continue peace conversations with this country.
dialogue.zh: 當時駐美華盛頓的日本和平使者仍試圖與美國繼續和平談判。
dialogue.ja: ワシントンにいる日本の平和使節は、この国との平和交渉を続けようとしていました。
dialogue.local: Japanese peace on boys in Washington sought to continue peace conversations with this country.
dialogue.en: Japanese peace on boys in Washington sought to continue peace conversations with this country.

dialogue.text: The Arizona was on fire, steel, smoke, and flames.
dialogue.zh: 亞利桑那號戰艦燃燒著，鋼鐵、煙霧與火焰交織。
dialogue.ja: アリゾナは炎に包まれ、鉄と煙と炎が立ち込めていました。
dialogue.local: The Arizona was on fire, steel, smoke, and flames.
dialogue.en: The Arizona was on fire, steel, smoke, and flames.

dialogue.text: The West Virginia, who was sunk, the California, and here we were upside down, such carnage that they had done to us.
dialogue.zh: 西維吉尼亞號沉沒，加利福尼亞號也受損，我們被顛覆，遭受了如此慘烈的破壞。
dialogue.ja: ウェストバージニアは沈没し、カリフォルニアも被害を受け、私たちはひっくり返されるほどの大惨事でした。
dialogue.local: The West Virginia, who was sunk, the California, and here we were upside down, such carnage that they had done to us.
dialogue.en: The West Virginia, who was sunk, the California, and here we were upside down, such carnage that they had done to us.

dialogue.text: It was hard to believe that any country on earth could have done that to our battle fleet.
dialogue.zh: 很難相信地球上有任何國家會對我們的戰鬥艦隊做出那樣的事。
dialogue.ja: 地球上のどの国が私たちの戦闘艦隊にそんなことをしたのか信じがたいものでした。
dialogue.local: It was hard to believe that any country on earth could have done that to our battle fleet.
dialogue.en: It was hard to believe that any country on earth could have done that to our battle fleet.

dialogue.text: No matter how long it may take us, it will overcome this premeditated invasion.
dialogue.zh: 無論花費多長時間，我們都將克服這次蓄意的入侵。
dialogue.ja: どれだけ時間がかかっても、この計画的な侵略を乗り越えるでしょう。
dialogue.local: No matter how long it may take us, it will overcome this premeditated invasion.
dialogue.en: No matter how long it may take us, it will overcome this premeditated invasion.

dialogue.text: The American people and their righteous might will win for the absolute victory.
dialogue.zh: 美國人民和他們正義的力量將贏得最終的勝利。
dialogue.ja: アメリカ国民とその正義の力が絶対的な勝利をもたらすでしょう。
dialogue.local: The American people and their righteous might will win for the absolute victory.
dialogue.en: The American people and their righteous might will win for the absolute victory.
